title: Tokyo, Osaka temperatures top 30°C later in year than ever before
paragraphs: Tokyo, Osaka temperatures top 30°C later in year than ever before
Tokyo climbed above 30°C by early afternoon on Wednesday (Oct 21), the threshold the Japan Meteorological Agency classifies as a "midsummer day".
TOKYO: Tokyo and Osaka topped 30°C on Wednesday (Oct 21), the latest in the year both cities have ever recorded such temperatures, a Japan weather official said.
